title: The Woodland Audience
alt: Pencil scene: An orb juggler performs in a quiet clearing for a leaf-eared cat and a woodgrain bird, beside a fallen oak leaf and acorns.
description: An orb juggler performs in a quiet clearing for a leaf-eared cat and a woodgrain bird, beside a fallen oak leaf and acorns.

title: Sunflower Shore
alt: Pencil scene: A curled serpent and a long-necked feathered bird pause beside a shallow stream, with a smiling sunflower and a maple leaf at the bank.
description: A curled serpent and a long-necked feathered bird pause beside a shallow stream, with a smiling sunflower and a maple leaf at the bank.

title: Pondside Procession
alt: A long shaggy rabbit and zigzag dog pass a pale pond while a wide frog holds out its long forked tongue from the far bank.
description: Three standout animal drawings keep their wonderfully odd poses during an unhurried passage beside a small pond.

title: The Rain Shelter
alt: A caped rabbit and a booted flower take shelter beneath the scalloped canopy of a sleepy bird-tree as a light pencil shower passes.
description: A caped rabbit and a walking flower borrow the shelter of a very patient bird-tree.

title: The Birdwatchers
alt: A watchful owl on its curved branch, an alert raven and an elaborate crested bird keep lookout across a quiet pencil clearing.
description: Three excellent observers keep watch over a clearing, each in a different direction.
